d:
This one took a long while. This is my first ever large cleaning job, and I don't have a drawing tablet or stylus, so this was pretty much all mouse. Majority of the cleaning is pretty eh, but I did my best with what I had. My inpaint just wasn't working and in some cases actively destroyed the panel as can be seen in some of the early panels so I just downloaded Gimp and did it by hand. I was learning on the go and trying out new things so the cleaning and text editing is pretty inconsistent, but I'm not letting that one MTL be the only translation for this doujin for who knows how long. I honestly wouldn't have done this doujin if it weren't for that.

I'm also currently learning Japanese, so like, 5% of the translation I did without MTL, but it was mostly the easy stuff. If you like this translation, thanks, and if you don't, then I don't blame you. I'm still learning and really, really would like this to get an actually good translation at some point.

I might also try and do the two other pretty bad MTL's that Kazakura has. However, as of right now, I'm taking a break. Might finish Witcher 3 now that I'm not doing this. If anyone has any tips on how to do a better cleaning, I'd be happy to hear.
n: [Doujinshi] [Bottle Ship Bottler (Kazakura)] InCha Couple ga You Gal-tachi to SEX Training Suru Hanashi 5 [English]
